problem_statement: TSCH adaptive channel selection can access invalid memory or perform invalid shifts when a locally configured hopping sequence contains channels outside the statistics window or is longer than that window. Such sequences must be rejected during initialization and reselection, leaving valid selection state and the hopping sequence unchanged. Valid sequences must retain normal adaptation, coordinator-only operation, learning-period gating, and update timing. Configurations whose tracked window exceeds the bitmap capacity or the range representable by a channel number must fail compilation; valid boundary configurations must still compile.
orientation: Host component tests compile the complete real TSCH channel-selection module with undefined-behavior sanitization. Clock and TSCH global inputs are supplied by fixtures; selection logic is unchanged. `run_tests` rebuilds, runs behavioral tests and compile-configuration probes, and executes unchanged upstream data-structure controls. No radio or Cooja is required. Tests under tests/ are protected.
